proves.claim: With items.barRulesAtAdd on, add and edit by a lane seat refuse a bar naming a file another lane owns, LANE_FOREIGN_PATH.

cli.io-item-bar-lane.foreign-path-refuse.why: Without it, a bar naming another lane's file costs a builder a claim cycle before pre-commit refuses it as OUTSIDE_LANE.

proves.claim: The LANE_FOREIGN_PATH refusal names the owning lane and the split filed --after the first piece.

cli.io-item-bar-lane.refusal-names-alter.why: Without it, the filer sees a refusal with no legal way forward.

proves.claim: With the setting off, or a bar naming only the item lane's files, add accepts the bar as before.

cli.io-item-bar-lane.off-or-own-lane-acc.why: Without it, the new rule could refuse bars that were legal.
